The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of Xe as a probe is an excellent tool for the identification of potential dioxygen binding sites in protein crystals.
xenon can be used to probe cavities in proteins, including those that might accommodate a dioxygen-binding site in a transient dioxygen-protein complex.
